item.title: VS Code Sessions UI hangs indefinitely when MCP tool returns large response (~100KB)
item.body:
When an MCP tool returns a large response (~100KB), the VS Code Sessions (Insiders) UI shows a loading state that never resolves. The data is returned successfully by the MCP server — the Copilot CLI in the terminal can access and display it — but the Sessions UI never renders the result.

Steps to Reproduce
Open VS Code Sessions (Insiders)
Invoke an MCP tool that returns a large dataset (e.g., a tool returning ~95 rows of tabular data in markdown format, totaling ~100KB)
Observe the UI shows a loading indicator that never completes
Expected Behavior
The response should render in the UI, or if too large, the UI should display a meaningful error/warning (e.g., "Response too large to display — showing first N results") rather than loading indefinitely.

Actual Behavior
The UI shows an infinite loading state. No data, no error, no timeout.

Additional Context
The same MCP tool call works perfectly in the Copilot CLI terminal — data is returned and accessible
The CLI logs the response as "Output too large to read at once (100.2 KB)" and saves to a temp file, confirming the data is received
Filtering/pagination at the MCP server level is a workaround, but the UI should handle large responses gracefully
Extension version: github.copilot-chat-0.40.2026031004
OS: Windows
